code: mb_ereg(pattern, string [, registers]) receives attacker-controlled regex text from the caller
note: The PoC controls the regex pattern passed into the mbstring regex engine.
The pattern is validated as UTF-8 before compilation, so the PoC must be valid UTF-8 while still exercising the vulnerable parser path.
The validated pattern is compiled by Oniguruma into an internal regex AST and cached for later matching.
During compilation Oniguruma recursively computes character lengths for regex nodes; the crash state indicates this path reaches node_char_len1 repeatedly.
A backreference causes node_char_len1 to revisit a captured subexpression through mem_env, creating the vulnerable recursive traversal that leads to the heap-use-after-free read.
